source.title: Pattern Breaking — Fast Fashion's Dirty Tricks

rationale: Experimental editorial website that turns research, statistics, interface pressure tactics, and policy chronology into one continuous visual narrative.
signals: interface pattern used as subject matter
notes: Direct inspection confirmed sections combining waste statistics, a live-style truck counter, examples of deceptive patterns, and a policy timeline. The observed value is narrative composition and rhetorical interface use; implementation technology is unknown.

decision.rationale: Adds a strong non-card editorial example where content, data, and interface behavior form the narrative mechanism rather than decoration.
